question: Should the shared `agent-transcript` skill discover Copilot session logs by default under `~/.copilot/session-state`, subject to this PR’s visible-dialogue allowlist and redaction rules?
rationale: This is a new default path that processes potentially sensitive local session data for possible public PR or issue provenance, so maintainers must explicitly accept the product and privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve the Copilot source
options.body: Accept default Copilot discovery with the PR’s strict visible-dialogue allowlist and fail-closed sanitization as the canonical shared-skill contract.
